args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because of the gassy smell, please treat this as urgent for safety. If you smell gas now: leave the flat, don't use light switches, naked flames or the oven, open doors/windows if you can on the way out, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). In immediate danger, call 999. Please don't use the oven until it has been checked. We've opened an emergency job for a Gas Safe engineer to attend; our target is within 24 hours. No firm is named yet, so we'll confirm the time as soon as we have it. The oven not heating is being looked at too. You'll hear from us again today.
